passages.locator: Discussion & Analysis / Summary Results of Operations / Fiscal Year 2025 Compared with Fiscal Year 2024 / Revenue
passages.text: Microsoft links revenue growth across all segments to Azure, Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, and the Gaming and Search/news advertising businesses.

passages.locator: Discussion & Analysis / Summary Results of Operations / Fiscal Year 2025 Compared with Fiscal Year 2024 / Operating expenses and operating income
passages.text: Microsoft says each segment contributed to the operating-profit increase. Higher operating spending reflected cloud/AI engineering and Gaming investments, including effects from buying Activision Blizzard.

passages.locator: Discussion & Analysis / Liquidity and Capital Resources / Cash Flows / Fiscal year 2025
passages.text: Microsoft attributes stronger operating cash generation mainly to larger customer receipts. Higher payments to suppliers and employees, together with income-tax payments, partly offset that improvement.
